The '''Ember of Vahl''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] coven of the nomadic [[Vahla]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that worshiped the [[God/Legends|goddess]] [[Vahl]], an embodiment of the destructive power of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was made up mostly of members of the Vahla, but would occasionally accept [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] of other species who proved their faith.<ref name="LECG" />

Several thousand years before the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]]&mdash;because of their destructive tendencies&mdash;the Ember of Vahl were decimated by the Jedi Knights. Since this event, the members have traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] looking for their lost [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], working as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], thieves, and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Remaining bitter and hateful towards the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], a number of Vahla helped the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunt]] down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. They were still present in the galaxy during the time of the Sith–Imperial War, working throughout the galaxy as independent bounty hunters.<ref name="LECG" />
